title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow up for pressure ulcer.

HPI
Pt is a 70 y.o. female presenting for evaluation of a pressure ulcer over the sacrum. Pt reports the area is painful and has been noted to be worsening over the last week. Pt is currently immobile.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Atorvastatin 20mg QD
Aspirin 81mg QD

Exam
Gen: alert, oriented x3, in no acute distress.
Skin: Stage 2 pressure ulcer noted over the sacrum. Area shows partial-thickness skin loss with minimal drainage and surrounding erythema. No purulent discharge noted.
Vitals: BP 132/84, HR 78, RR 16, Temp 98.6 F, SpO2 98% on RA.

Assessment
1. Stage 2 pressure ulcer of the sacrum.

Plan
1. Wound care: Cleanse with normal saline, apply hydrocolloid dressing to the pressure ulcer.
2. Repositioning: Pt instructed on Q2h turning schedule.
3. F/u: Return to clinic in 2 weeks for wound check.

Electronically signed,
D. Kowalski, MD
10/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the sacral region, stage 2: L89.152 (HCC 382).

distractors.why: The stage is documented: it decides the code and the HCC.

hccs.label: Pressure Ulcer of Skin with Partial Thickness Skin Loss
